guardVerification: Fresh nested shared-launcher cap readback in a read-only control subprocess; same cgroup, no expanded reservation
ipcPolicy: Private HOME/XDG and no display or desktop bus in Blender; original user-manager address supplied only to the read-only guard subprocess
geometry: explicit axis-aligned body envelopes and declared ports only; not extracted game meshes

coordinateConvention.bodyRotation: axis-aligned envelope already supplied; rotationDeg metadata only, never applied twice
coordinateConvention.ports: explicit project-local coordinates, not body offsets

assetProjection.policy: Source bytes unchanged; omit only explicitly unauthored normalizer fallbacks from art

omittedFallbacks.reason: Absent from the literal contract; not an authored service envelope

annotations.detail: Зона обслуживания не задана исходным контрактом; native yaw неизвестен. 16×28×29 м: общий fallback нормализатора, не доказанный сервисный габарит. Контур не нарисован.

rotationHandling: prefer footprint / rotatedEnvelope / supplied width-depth; preserve source rotation metadata without rotating axis-aligned envelopes twice
campusGraph: exact owned externalLinks/powerConnections retained as scene JSON metadata; this renderer does not draw campus routes; author-factory-sheets emits the separate paginated SVGs
supportScope: Local active supports only in the rendered view; all source records retained in supportsJSON; exact campus support coordinates are on the SVG support schedules
portPolicy: explicit ports array only; point is project-local absolute; direction and face preserved; containers need no electrical anchor

blendConversion.operation: lossless native zstd decompression; original render and compressed file unchanged
